one_line: Open on the finished, eye-catching object with a three-word headline, then show it being made and hung.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 top-down close-up of a large silver holographic paper star on a checked cloth, the camera drifting across it. No face. Text, centre-left: "קישוט אוריגמי לסוכה". No clear speech in 0-3 s (transcript garbled).
q1_hook.why: The shiny finished object fills the frame and the headline names the topic in three words, so it works as a cover and with sound off (H1, H7, T3). It shows the result before the process (H2) and sets up "how is it made" (H5). No face or voice (against H4).

beats.what: Holographic star close-up, camera drifting; headline text
beats.why: The result first, with the topic named

beats.what: Zoom-blur transition; hands take a sheet out of a pink quilted bag
An adult and a girl fold paper at a table in a sukkah; one top-down hands shot
beats.why: Shows it is a shared, doable activity

beats.what: Zoom-blur, the adult holds folded pieces, the girl is motion-blurred
beats.why: Transition time with little new information

beats.what: A girl holds the finished star above her head and smiles at the lens
beats.why: The emotional high point of the Reel

beats.what: The star hangs on a white sukkah wall by a string; hands adjust it
Two girls hold two origami books; text "חג שמח"; last frame blurred
beats.why: The only glimpse of what is sold

q2_flow.why: A short arc, result, making, a smiling child, result in place, with a new picture about every 2 s keeps a 19 s Reel moving (K2, R3, R2). The payoff at 0:11 comes mid-Reel and the last 6 s repeat the star and add the books late (R4, R1). Nothing invites a comment, send or save (R5).

q3_cta.what: None. The video has only "חג שמח" at 0:17, a greeting. The caption has no ask, link or price.
q3_cta.why: Nobody is told where to buy or what is in the kit, and the books show for about 2 s at the very end, so interest cannot turn into an action (C6, C7). It works as a pleasant holiday post only; the clean festive close costs it every conversion step.

q4_shown.what: The finished star 0:00-0:02; a sheet from a pink bag 0:04; an adult and a girl folding in a sukkah 0:05-0:07; a girl holding the star over her head 0:11-0:12; the star hung on a wall 0:13-0:16; two girls with origami books 0:17-0:18. No price.
q4_shown.why: Result, then making, then a smiling child, then the result in place is a persuasive order for a craft (H2, K2). But the kit and books show only in the last 2 s, so the viewer sees a craft, not what to buy (S1, H3). Children's faces show; consent is not visible (S5).

q5_edit.what: About 9 shots in 19 s (about 2 s each), joined by zoom-blur transitions at about 3 s and 8 s plus a motion blur at 10 s. Static and handheld shots. Text 0:00-0:02 and 0:17 only. The last frame is a blurred handheld shot.
q5_edit.why: Quick shots and zoom transitions suit a festive, music-style edit and keep new pictures coming (E2, R3), but the blurs at 0:03, 0:08 and 0:10 hide the steps and the final frame. With no clear speech and almost no text, the story rests on the pictures alone (E4, T1).

q6_topic.what: A holiday craft: folding a holographic origami star for the sukkah with a child; it serves parents looking for a Sukkot decoration activity.
q6_topic.why: A dated seasonal moment parents plan for (K7), with a warm, playful peak when the child wears the star (K1). The link to what is sold is missing, so it reads as a pretty craft rather than a product story (K5).

q7_filmed.what: Top-down static close-up of the star on a checked cloth; handheld medium shots in a sukkah in daylight; one top-down hands shot; a girl holding the star over her head to the lens; a static wall shot with hands; a handheld end shot.
q7_filmed.why: Daylight and a real sukkah look native (H8, F7). The star's shine fills the frame in the first and wall shots (F4). The top-down fold shot puts the viewer in the folder's seat but lasts about 1 s (F5). The blurred end shot is not sharp (F7).

q8_text.on_screen: 0:00-0:02 white outlined text, three short lines, centre-left, about 43 to 57 percent down: "קישוט אוריגמי לסוכה". 0:17-0:18 "חג שמח" over the left book, about 62 percent down. No subtitles, no labels, no ask.
q8_text.caption: "חג שמח ונוצץ ✨️". 16 words in 4 short lines: a greeting, then craft kits for holographic origami "לקישוט הסוכה ובכלל !". No ask, no question, no hashtags, no disclosure words (a coauthor tag, palphot, is in the post data).
q8_text.why: The headline is short, readable and inside the safe zone (T3, T4, T5), and the caption has product words parents might search (T7). But the caption opens with a greeting, has no hashtags, and shows no partnership wording for the coauthor (T7, T8).

weak_points: Product only in the last 2 s; no ask, price or kit name; zoom blurs and a blurred last frame; unclear audio; children's faces with no visible consent; no hashtags.
lumebook_takeaway: Open on a close top-down shot of the finished page or cover with a three-word headline, then hands opening the book, and end on a clear ask. No child needed.
not_verified: Audio: the transcript is a garbled line over 0-7.8 s and the adult's mouth is open at 0:06, so speech cannot be ruled out (not quoted); music cannot be told, so the first pass's "no speech" is unconfirmed. The brand of the kit, books and paper; the roles of the adult and children; whether the coauthor palphot is the seller. Correction: "חג שמח" appears at 0:17 only and the last frame at 0:18 is motion-blurred.
